events.name: Bash
events.head: Check repo state, stale references, reminder keys, task states and whether the key is in git
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git status --short | grep -v '^??' ; git log --oneline -3; git rev-parse origin/main | cut -c1-7; echo ---stale; grep -rnE "emails/batch|held until Tantra|TANTRA_NOTE|TANTRA_WAIT|per-contact send" cloud/src cloud/funnel cloud/admin-ui app/src app/scripts/probe-*.mjs 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200 | head -20; echo ---keys; grep -nE "plan_ready|replay|nudge|low_eng|registered" cloud/src/reminders.ts | cut -c1-170 | head -40; echo ---pay; grep -nE "reminder|enrol" cloud/src/payments.ts | cut -c1-170 | head; echo ---probehead; sed -n 1,30p app/scripts/probe-ta

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate follow-up campaign code, probe sections and how the local centre is started
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rnlE "no.?show|low.?engagement|followup|follow_up" cloud/src | head; echo ---; grep -nE "FOLLOW|followup|no_show|noshow|nudge" cloud/src/reminders.ts cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts | cut -c1-180 | head -30; echo ---probe; grep -nE "^section|section\(|T-235|follow" app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | cut -c1-160 | head -40; echo ---run; grep -rnE "8960|8882" cloud/package.json cloud/scripts/*.sh app/scripts/run-chain.sh cloud/scripts/local-runner.py 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200 | head -12; ls cloud/scripts | head -40; lsof -iTCP:8960 -iTCP:8882 -sT

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the local stack start scripts (secret values masked)
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; sed -n 1,40p scripts/local-stack.sh | cut -c1-220; echo ----; cat scripts/run-dev.sh | cut -c1-220 | head -30; grep -n "DODO\|ADMIN_KEY" .dev.vars 2>/dev/null | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'
